name: Amasa
bio: Amasa was the son of Abigail, David's sister, and so a cousin to Joab and Abishai; when Absalom launched his rebellion, he appointed Amasa commander of his army in Joab's place (2 Samuel 17:25). Amasa's fraught path from Absalom's general to David's own, and his eventual violent end at Joab's hand, is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
